comment_regular: Verified PathGrid child-record predicate. For a candidate TESChildCell, compares its child cell with TESPathGrid.parentCell and delegates on mismatch. For the owning cell, only REFR/ACHR/ACRE records are accepted, and only when the reference is nonpersistent; other record types return false.
